reviews.text:
I took my dog ​​to the vet on May 1st, 2026, for a urinary tract infection and ear infection. The vet didn't even examine her, except to tell me she was overweight and had a little tartar on her teeth.

He didn't give her a full examination.

I paid $510 for the supposed consultation and medication.

She weighed 80 pounds.

Three days later, she stopped eating. She couldn't eat anymore, and I had to feed her with a can of food like a baby. She started swelling up and couldn't walk anymore.

When I contacted them to have her euthanized, they told me they didn't have room for that.

I went to another clinic where they gave her a full examination, and they discovered a tumor in her throat, something the other vet never told me.

She suffered for a week and a half without eating properly because I never felt the tumor in her throat and I had to feed her with a can of food.

She was so swollen she weighed 100 pounds; I had to have her euthanized there yesterday, Thursday.

I'm really disappointed with the Villeray Papineau clinic. I don't recommend it, and I paid $500 for nothing. They should refund me. The vet has changed a lot; he's not the same as before.
Only the cash matters.

I don't recommend them.

Fill a complaint with the Quebec Order of Veterinarians.

They're all crooks, liars, and thieves. What's more, if you ask questions or show any critical thinking, you get called illiterate. And then there's the aptly named Dubé, the self-proclaimed veterinarian, who belittles me by saying I didn't go to university. An appeal to authority, especially since I have a degree. An arrogant, aggressive man who refuses to be questioned. A coward. He attacks those he considers weaker instead of arguing like a professional. He picked the wrong target. He knew before I even arrived that I doubted the legitimacy of the fees. Upon entering the office, he kicked the bench, which hit the wall, clearly to intimidate me. To silence my questions. Once again, he picked the wrong target. In the end, despite an agreement from the start, he refused to treat my cat. Run away!!!! Oh!!! Also! Don't say why you're going back if there's a problem; they'll tamper with your file.

The vet showed no empathy or nonchalance, his examination was cursory, and he offered no solutions. He handled my pet roughly and coldly. I have never experienced anything like it. I absolutely do not recommend them! I left feeling utterly disgusted.
Good service, and  professional!!

Worst veterinary in Montréal. I brought my cat here four years ago, and they told me he needed two of his teeth removed so we did. But, he didn't get better, and we went to another veterinary place and there we found out he had a tumor. I just can't wrap my head around that they couldn't find that in the first place. To add on, the receptionist was extremely rude when I was panicking because my cat was in a lot of pain, she had no empathy whatsoever. Also, the second place told us they left the teeth holes wide open, no stitches. They made my cat suffer for no reason weeks before his death. They called me a year later to ask how he was and I couldn't even get myself to answer because of my grief. Please , do not go to this place if you care about your pet.
A very humane vet. No pressure. Explains things well. Warm welcome.

Didn't need to be a client beforehand, got lucky with an appointment the same day.
Nice staff the receptionist was really sweet and nice:)

Update June 2026:
After 5 years, I'm still going to this clinic and it's been flawless! We've had two dental cleanings, two spayings, and all the vaccinations. I've never been disappointed with the service, and Dr. Dubé is always friendly. He puts things in perspective when I'm worried about my dogs because they're like my children. Believe me, I wouldn't take them there if I didn't trust him!

Thank you to Dr. Dubé and his entire team for the excellent care and the positive atmosphere!

Update: I continue to go to Dr. Dubé for my beautiful Inka, and I even transferred my other dog, who is generally more difficult than the female.
I don't understand all the negative comments about this clinic. They are always wonderful to me and my animals. I've had many bad experiences in the past with dishonest vets who care more about their wallets than the health of their animals, but that's not the case with Dr. Dubé!

I recommend going to him so your pet receives proper care and your trust and money aren't taken advantage of like with other vets.

An honest vet

My first visit was extremely disappointing. The staff's lack of professionalism and empathy was striking. The veterinary assistant handled my pet roughly, without explanation or care, causing obvious pain. When I expressed my concern, the reaction was dismissed rather than taken seriously.

The veterinarian, for his part, seemed disengaged, handling my pet roughly and performing the procedure hastily, without any attempt to reassure him. This experience left me with a very negative impression regarding the quality of care and respect for animals. I do not recommend this clinic.

I brought my cat in for a loose tooth and had an appointment the following week for the surgery and a dental cleaning. The prices were much more competitive than elsewhere, and my cat is recovering very well. I definitely recommend this veterinary clinic!
The staff is welcoming and professional. I trust Dr. Dubé and his team. He has been my animals' veterinarian for many years.

This veterinary clinic has been treating my dog ​​for several years. The staff are honest, professional, and knowledgeable. They are always ready to welcome your pet. I highly recommend them; don't hesitate.

Thank you so much!
The clinic allowed me to have one last human moment with my cat. The whole team was extremely kind and empathetic.
An honest veterinarian who doesn't even try to sell us all sorts of services or products

A sad experience with my dog: I left him in the morning for a dental cleaning and lipoma removal. I was told everything was fine and I came to pick him up at 5 pm. After paying the hefty bill (which I was expecting, all things considered), I was told there was a complication and that I had to go to an emergency vet clinic immediately because they were closing for the weekend… They handed my dog ​​back to me in a deplorable state with active bleeding on his chest, and I was running to the Laval Veterinary Hospital to save him. It was a close call. He was in pre-shock with a slowed heart rate and a low body temperature; they had to warm him up and intervene immediately. I received a brief call from the Villeray Clinic a few days later from the vet's assistant to check on my dog's condition, and that was it.
I'm astonished that a veterinarian would discharge an animal he had treated who wasn't stable.

Thank you for taking such good care of our new little Akira. We were previously with you for our cats, and it was a pleasure to return to the clinic. A warm welcome from the moment we arrived, excellent advice, and superb care. We felt comfortable and confident, and so did the animals!

See you soon!

Marie-Ève ​​and Stéphane
Super friendly and respectful.

I want to thank the entire veterinary team for their professionalism and kindness. I was very worried about my little Chanelle, but they made me feel at ease as soon as I arrived. The vet took the time to explain each step gently and patiently. A big thank you also to Joe at reception—so welcoming, smiling, and helpful! Thanks to you, Chanelle received excellent care, and I had complete peace of mind. I highly recommend this clinic! 💖🐾
Price increase in 2 months for no reason. A difference of more than $20 from where I ordered before. I will not be going back.

This clinic hasn't changed in at least two years: The staff are aggressive, dishonest, and lack compassion. They even killed my friend's cat because of their mistake. Accidents happen, but they refused to offer any compensation, neither an apology nor a refund. Furthermore, responding to clients with lengthy, passive-aggressive paragraphs is extremely disrespectful and unprofessional.

This is the clinic where I've had my dogs' teeth cleaned several times, always with excellent service and much cheaper than elsewhere. You don't necessarily go to this clinic for fancy service, but the vet is very competent and honest!

For the past few months, I've noticed a decline in the service for orders placed through La Vitrine. My orders are taking over two weeks to arrive.

Right now, I have an order from September 6th that hasn't been processed yet (it's September 24th). I've tried calling during business hours, but there's no answer. However, when I did call, the receptionist hung up the phone even while I was speaking to them.

I've been ordering from them for over a year and was very satisfied, but I have to admit I don't understand this drop in quality.
Excellent clinic

I consulted Dr. Dubé for the past three years for my cat's allergies. I always received the same diagnosis of dermatitis and the same medication, which had no effect, despite several visits based on the same principle.

I finally sought a second opinion after mentioning that my cat was breathing strangely (to which he laughed, saying it was normal since I was holding him to listen to his breathing). Each time, I paid full price without any improvement in my cat's condition.

The second opinion I received identified asthma in my cat. Luckily, I was able to trust my instincts and recognize it before he suffered too much. I was also informed that the medication I had been receiving for three years was not consistent with the diagnosis of skin allergies (despite Dr. Dubé's sharp rebuttal to this point) because, although it could help with itching, it primarily affected the ears. This concerns Surolan, in case any other client reading this has any doubts about their pet.

I expressed my astonishment to the veterinary assistant over the phone, who not only made me repeat my name for over five minutes without knowing how to spell it and getting increasingly irritated, but also gave me a very poor reception and almost hung up on me when I asked to have my file transferred.

Then, the veterinarian sent me an email defending his diagnosis (dermatitis) in the most unpleasant way possible, literally accusing me of several things, such as believing lies and a lack of respect that he himself supposedly attributed to him. I received no direct call from him to clarify the situation, just a warning not to come back to the clinic based on statements distorted by his employee.

Besides, I would never have gone back anyway, since the second opinion I received allowed my cat to recover in just a few days, compared to three years of the same symptoms following the treatment at this clinic.

Luckily, I followed my intuition and diagnosed him before he suffered too much, because this clinic seems completely indifferent to your concerns and even laughs in your face.

I do not recommend this place.

My little Triskell had a urinary blockage, and having recognized the signs, I rushed him to this clinic. The wait can be very, very long, so you have to be patient, but you can tell the whole team is very busy and dedicated.

My cat was hospitalized and was having a very hard time (as was I), but he was pampered and received excellent care. The entire team was so kind, and the post-hospitalization advice was invaluable.

A huge thank you for your work and dedication! :)

I took my senior dog in for a dental cleaning, and everything went very well. I was able to get an appointment quickly, the whole team took great care of him, and everything was done professionally. My dog ​​had a lot of plaque and tartar buildup, and now he has white teeth! :)

It seems I wasn't lucky! I was charged $1300 for my cat's teeth to be removed. The invoice says 4 teeth removed, but in person, they said 5 teeth were removed. They probably added a tooth to justify the $1300. It costs less elsewhere; shop around. I deeply regret believing them to be honest and trusting them! Don't charge everyone the same price.
They've been taking such good care of my cats for a few years now! Always excellent service from start to finish.

I took my cat Tommy to this clinic for a teeth cleaning and two extractions.
The doctor's thorough examination and his experience on the day of the examination put us at ease.
I made an appointment for the surgery. Everything went smoothly.
I really thank the doctor for his kindness.
And I recommend this clinic to everyone.
And to all my fellow Iranians.
The clinic and staff were very welcoming; finally, a clinic with reasonable prices. Thank you.
The technician Cathy was lovely, both with my pet and me. Thank you.
A very nice experience, truly attentive and without being overbearing.
THANKS !
THANKS !

First time here and very satisfied! Good neighborhood vet, quick appointment scheduling, and honest diagnosis without exaggeration! My dog ​​Bob's teeth cleaning went well! Thanks again! Especially for the very affordable prices compared to other places that are a bit overpriced...
The receptionist, technician, and veterinarian were all very kind people. The prices are reasonable.

A "common sense" veterinary clinic, without overdiagnosing. The only veterinarian is frank, honest, and doesn't pressure you for things that may not be critical, like other clinics do.

Availability is quite good; I've rarely been unable to miss an appointment within 7 days.

Competitive prices; however, the clinic should be more transparent from the start about the prices for each procedure.

I recommend it.
This is the clinic I recommend. The vet is friendly and attentive. Best prices in town for teeth cleaning.
Thank you, Ms. Perron!
They take really good care of my dog without unnecessary tests and fees

A very good experience! I had my cat neutered at this clinic and I left very satisfied. The receptionist was very helpful and had a great attitude, and the prices are more than reasonable compared to other clinics.
I highly recommend them!

A superb clinic! I went there for a checkup with my Shiba Inu, who is very fearful and aggressive when it comes to being touched by strangers. Dr. Dubé was able to calm her down perfectly, control her, and soothe her. We were very impressed by his skills, as it's the first time we've encountered a veterinarian who can handle our dog like that (and we've seen quite a few in six years)! Future visits to the vet will therefore be much less stressful for us and our little Shiba!
They do not care about your animal. Worst clinic.
